verses.en: By the sky, (displaying) the Zodiacal Signs
By the promised Day (of Judgment)
By one that witnesses, and the subject of the witness
Woe to the makers of the pit (of fire)
Fire supplied (abundantly) with fuel
Behold! they sat over against the (fire)

verses.ar: وَّهُمۡ عَلٰي مَا يَفۡعَلُوۡنَ بِالۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ شُهُوۡدٌؕ‏
verses.en: And they witnessed (all) that they were doing against the Believers

verses.ar: وَمَا نَقَمُوۡا مِنۡهُمۡ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡا بِاللّٰهِ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡحَمِيۡدِۙ‏
verses.en: And they ill-treated them for no other reason than that they believed in Allah, Exalted in Power, Worthy of all Praise

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡ لَهٗ مُلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ شَهِيۡدٌؕ‏
verses.en: Him to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allah is Witness to all things

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ فَتَنُوا الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ وَالۡمُؤۡمِنٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوۡبُوۡا فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ الۡحَرِيۡقِؕ‏
verses.en: Those who persecute (or draw into temptation) the Believers, men and women, and do not turn in repentance, will have the Penalty of Hell: They will have the Penalty of the Burning Fire

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنّٰتٌ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُؕ ذٰلِكَ الۡفَوۡزُ الۡكَبِيۡرُؕ‏
verses.en: For those who believe and do righteous deeds, will be Gardens; beneath which rivers flow: That is the great Salvation, (the fulfilment of all desires)
Truly strong is the Grip (and Power) of thy Lord
It is He Who creates from the very beginning, and He can restore (life)
And He is the Oft-Forgiving, Full of Loving-Kindness
Lord of the Throne of Glory
Doer (without let) of all that He intends
Has the story reached thee, of the forces
Of Pharaoh and the Thamud
And yet the Unbelievers (persist) in rejecting (the Truth)
But Allah doth encompass them from behind
Nay, this is a Glorious Qur'an
(Inscribed) in a Tablet Preserved
